in_marathi.name: Ramhari
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramhari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ram means 'God' and Hari means 'servant' or 'God in human form'. Ramhari is a devotee or servant of Lord Rama.

vedic_reference.note: Ram is a popular name in Hinduism, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rama', meaning 'pleasing to God' or 'God in human form'. Hari is another popular name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Hari', meaning 'God'. Ramhari can be interpreted as 'servant of Ram' or 'devotee of Ram'.
